rationale.text: A select with an unlabelled optgroup is used to filter a list and sits outside any form, with no form owner. Criterion 11.8 is asked of each form, which the glossary defines as a form tag or a tag with role form, and the text does not say whether a list outside a form is covered. The custom check answers cannot_tell (step 1); only the record supports this branch. The finding is needs_review at both levels: not_enabled at fail_only, cannot_tell at full.

citations.quote: Balise <form> ou balise possédant un attribut WAI-ARIA role="form".
